description: Creates a new entry in the workflow history for a Sitecore item.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

id.description: The ID of the item to have a new history entry added. Supply this or path.

language.description: The language that will be used as source language.

newState.description: The ID of the new state. If not provided - current item workflow state will be used.

oldState.description: The ID of the old state. If not provided - current item workflow state will be used.

path.description: The path of the item to have a new history entry added. Supply this or id.

name: common-new-item-workflow-event
